title: Stooq OHLCV Record
description: A single OHLCV (Open, High, Low, Close, Volume) data point returned by the Stooq Historical Data API for a given ticker symbol and date.

Date.description: The trading date for this data point. Format is YYYY-MM-DD for daily, weekly, monthly, quarterly, and yearly intervals. For intraday intervals, includes time component.

Open.description: The opening price of the security for the given period.

High.description: The highest price reached during the given period.

Low.description: The lowest price reached during the given period.

Close.description: The closing price of the security for the given period.

Volume.description: The number of shares or contracts traded during the given period. May be zero or absent for indices, currencies, and some instruments.
